title: Test tooling ships into the runtime environment
description: Pipfile declares a test framework declared in Pipfile `[packages]` instead of `[dev-packages]`. A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a test framework declared in Pipfile `[packages]` instead of `[dev-packages]`.
remediation: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix a test framework declared in Pipfile `[packages]` instead of `[dev-packages]`.
limitation: It matches a test framework declared in Pipfile `[packages]` instead of `[dev-packages]` in the parsed Pipfile; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
